# Game data reference

<!-- Generated by tools/data-export/export.js from index.html and tools/battle-sim/baseline.json. Do not edit by hand: change the code, then run `node tools/data-export/export.js`. -->

Every number the battle prototype (`index.html`) uses, as it stands. The [design doc](../design-doc.md) is the target; this is the current build. Where they disagree, `node tools/data-check/check.js` reports it, and [implementation status](../implementation-status.md) tracks it. Formulas are explained in [battle math](../systems/battle-math.md).

## Party

Base stats at level 0. A character's HP, MP, ATK, DEF and MAG are scaled by `0.6 + 0.04 × level`, where the level comes from the encounter (level 10: ×1.00, level 20: ×1.40, level 30: ×1.80). Speed is not scaled. Tick speed is `max(8, 30 − Speed)`; an action of Delay *d* comes back after *d* × tick speed ticks, and one turn-order slot is 12 ticks.

## Stress Check outcomes

| Afflicted | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Berserk | Repeats their last command automatically. |
| Zombie | Cannot be healed. |
| Paralyze | Skips the turn and loses 8% HP. |
| Confuse | Attacks an ally who is not Afflicted. |
| Slow | Does nothing, and their next turn is pushed back 3 slots. |

| Inspired | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Fearless | No Stress gain for the rest of the battle. |
| Disrupt | Each action pushes a random enemy back 2 slots. |
| Rally | Cannot be pushed back. Allies −2 Stress each time this character acts. |
| Focus | Every hit is a critical for 3 turns. |
| Reraise | Revives once at 25% HP if KO'd. |

- **Port of Vesk · Tide-Widow** (`widow`). At half HP she enters phase 2 and releases 2 Drowned Sailors, which re-form 3 of her turns after you defeat them. Undertow pushes whoever is about to act back 3 slots. (The Thing That Drifted Ashore)
- **Moogle Market · Ruri ×2** (`ruri2`). Two Ruris, each claiming to be the one you killed. They attack each other more as one weakens, and Charm adds 12 Stress to whoever is closest to breaking. (Tomie)
- **Lumen · Orlen and the Great Organ** (`orlen`). Orlen fills Overdrive as your party gains Stress; when full, he and the Organ attack together with Requiem. Counter-Melody makes him hold his voice, but the Organ will play into it to clear the way. Destroy the Organ and it is rebuilt 4 of his turns later. (Honored Ancestors · The Human Chair)
- **The Hellstar · Final battle** (`final`). The Hellstar marks a target with Gaze, then Devours it, but only while its Tongue is attached. Blink on the marked ally makes it look elsewhere. Sever the Tongue to buy time; it regrows. Its Overdrive fills as your party gains Stress. (Uzumaki · Hellstar Remina)
- **Test · Spiral Ringer** (`t_kiri`). It adds 6 Danger every turn, and each Toll adds 14 Stress. High Danger makes Spiral Cut hit harder, and Lullaby clears the Stress. (Uzumaki)
- **Test · Blood Drinker** (`t_natsu`). Heavy hits on one target at a time, each adding 10 Stress. Once it is below 75% HP, Drain hits the ally with the lowest HP% and heals it. Cure and Soothe keep the target alive. (Blood-Slurping Darkness)
- **Test · Funeral Dolls** (`t_tetsugi`). Four fast, weak dolls that target the ally with the highest max HP. Counter strikes back, but the first doll it catches goes for someone else while Counter is ready. (A Doll's Hellish Burial)
- **Test · Hanging Balloon** (`t_miren`). Every 4th turn, Noose Drop hits the whole party hard. Characters who are airborne from Jump avoid it. (The Hanging Balloons)
- **Test · Earthbound Woman** (`t_goku`). Her DEF makes light hits do almost nothing, and she hits 10% harder every turn she takes. Summon Hound breaks through and Howl softens Topple. (The Earthbound)
- **Test · Red Turtleneck** (`t_hisui`). A fast duelist with a 45% crit rate who targets the fastest party member. Every crit on Hisui gives her +10% damage; at +30% it stops attacking her. (Tomio • Red Turtleneck)
- **Test · Record Singers** (`t_kuro`). Five weak singers, each adding 4 Stress to the party every turn. Darkga hits all of them at once. (Used Record)
- **Test · Long Dreamer** (`t_ren`). Its damage rises 25% with every turn it takes. Delay Shot keeps it from acting, so it stays weaker, but Breaking it wakes it angry. (The Long Dream)
- **Test · Amigara Wall** (`t_sayo`). After 9 of its turns the party walks into the wall and you lose. Its Calling pushes everyone who hears it back 2 slots. Quick Song gets you more turns first. Counter-Melody turns a Calling into a Beckon that pushes back only whoever acts next. (The Enigma of Amigara Fault)
- **Test · Headless Sculpture** (`t_kugai`). Always targets the ally with the lowest HP%, and after two Chisels Behead hits for massive damage. Provoke delays Behead one turn; then it ignores Provoke, so Cover the weak. (Headless Sculptures)
- **Test · Grease Father** (`t_fuyori`). You start with no items, it has 80 DEF, and Grease Rain adds 16 Stress to everyone without Earplugs. Mix restocks the bag and Acid lowers its DEF. (Glyceride)
- **Test · Star Fragment** (`t_shio`). At 95 Danger, Lost Turns come often. Its Gaze names a target one turn before Devour. Foresee removes Lost Turns, and Blink on the marked ally makes it Gaze at someone else. (Hellstar Remina)

## Enemy scripts

Each enemy runs a priority list: on planning, the first rule that holds picks the skill, and the plan shows in the turn order. Rules marked *reacts* are re-checked when the party acts. Rank is the skill's Delay.

### Tide-Widow (`widow`)

Phases: **p1** Above 50% HP; **p2** 50% HP or below (enters with Release).
Parts: Drowned Sailor, re-forms 3 turns after defeat.

1. Phase 1: roll Lullaby 25%, Undertow 25%, Attack 50%
2. Phase 2: roll Lullaby 20%, Undertow 45%, Attack 35%

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Attack | 3 | Physical | Random ally | 1.4× ATK | 15% crit chance. |
| Undertow | 4 | Physical, Delay | Ally whose turn comes next | 0.6× ATK | Pushes the ally about to act back 3 slots (+12 Stress). |
| Lullaby | 5 | Sound, Stress | All allies | — | +14 Stress to each ally. +6 Danger. |
| Release | 4 | Summon, Phase | — | — | Phase 2 entry. 2 Drowned Sailors crawl out of her body. Each re-forms 3 of her turns after it is defeated. |

- Undertow picks its target when it acts, not when it plans, so the turn order you choose decides who it hits.

### Drowned Sailor (`sailor`)

1. Every turn: roll Attack 50% (25% if an ally is within 25 Stress of a Stress Check or fleeing), Stench 50% (75% then)

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Attack | 3 | Physical | Random ally | 1.2× ATK | 8% crit chance. |
| Stench | 3 | Physical, Stress | Ally closest to a Stress Check or fleeing | 0.4× ATK | +8 Stress to the ally closest to a Stress Check or fleeing. |

- Part of Tide-Widow. It re-forms after being defeated and collapses if its parent falls.

### Archbishop Orlen (`orlen`)

Phases: **p1** Above 50% HP; **p2** 50% HP or below: the ancestors wake (Sermon +30 Stress).
Parts: Great Organ, re-forms 4 turns after defeat at 50% HP.

1. If Counter-Melody is up (he holds his voice) *(reacts)*: **Crozier**
2. If Overdrive is full and the Great Organ is standing: **Requiem**
3. If Overdrive is full but the Great Organ is destroyed: **Lament**
4. If the Great Organ is below 50% HP: **Benediction**, chance 40%
5. If at least one ally can hear sound attacks: **Sermon**, chance 45% (75% if a listener is within 25 Stress of a Stress Check or fleeing)
6. Otherwise: **Crozier**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Requiem | 6 | Combined, Sound, Stress, Delay | All allies | 1.0× ATK | Orlen and the Great Organ attack together: damage, +20 Stress and pushed back 2 for each ally. The Organ's next turn is synced to Orlen's. |
| Lament | 4 | Sound, Stress | Ally closest to a Stress Check or fleeing (can hear sound) (ignores Provoke) | — | With no Organ to play, Orlen spends his Overdrive alone: +35 Stress to the ally with the most Stress. |
| Benediction | 4 | Heal | — | — | Restores up to 300 HP to the Great Organ. |
| Sermon | 4 | Sound, Stress | Ally closest to a Stress Check or fleeing (can hear sound) (ignores Provoke) | — | +20 Stress (+30 in phase 2). +4 Danger. |
| Crozier | 3 | Physical | Random ally | 1.5× ATK | 10% crit chance. |

- Overdrive fills by 0.6 for every point of Stress your party gains. When it is full, the Overdrive checks at the top of the list fire.
- Checks marked "reacts" are re-checked the moment you act and again when it acts, so it can answer a counter you play after it planned.
- Combined attacks use both actors' turns: the partner's next turn is synced to this one.

### Great Organ (`organ`)

1. If Counter-Melody is up (it draws the song out for Orlen) *(reacts)*: **Chord**
2. If this is its 5th, 10th, 15th… turn: **Chord**
3. Otherwise: **Drone**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Chord | 3 | Sound, Stress, Delay | All allies | — | +15 Stress and pushed back 2 for each ally. +5 Danger. |
| Drone | 3 | Physical | All allies | 0.8× ATK | Hits the whole party. |

- Checks marked "reacts" are re-checked the moment you act and again when it acts, so it can answer a counter you play after it planned.
- Part of Archbishop Orlen. It re-forms after being defeated and collapses if its parent falls.

### Ruri (`ruri`)

Phases: **p1** Another Ruri is alive (or she came alone); **p2** Last Ruri standing: Spite, ATK +30%.

1. If another Ruri is alive: **Jealousy**, chance 15%, rising to 75% as the weakest copy loses HP
2. Otherwise: roll Charm 45% (54% if an ally is within 20 Stress of a Stress Check or fleeing), Slap 55% (46% then)

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Jealousy | 3 | Physical | Another enemy | 1.4× ATK | Attacks the most wounded copy of herself. |
| Charm | 3 | Stress | Ally closest to a Stress Check or fleeing | — | +12 Stress to the ally closest to a Stress Check or fleeing. |
| Slap | 3 | Physical | Random ally | 1.3× ATK | 15% crit chance. |

### Ainsel, the Unwound (`unwound`)

Phases: **p1** The Hellstar is above 50% HP; **p2** The Hellstar is at 50% HP or below: Offbeat +20 Stress.

1. If this is its 3rd, 6th, 9th… turn: **Unwind**
2. Otherwise: **Offbeat**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Unwind | 3 | Physical | All allies | 1.0× ATK | Hits the whole party. |
| Offbeat | 3 | Sound, Stress, Physical | Ally who acted last | 0.8× ATK | Hits whoever acted last (decided when it acts): damage, +12 Stress (+20 in phase 2). |

- Offbeat picks its target when it acts, not when it plans, so the turn order you choose decides who it hits.
- Part of The Hellstar. It reads its parent's HP for its phase.

### The Hellstar (`hellstar`)

Phases: **p1** Above 50% HP; **p2** 50% HP or below: it opens wider (Danger 100, Devour 3.2×, Tongue regrows in 2).
Parts: Hellstar Tongue, re-forms 3 turns after defeat (2 in phase 2).

1. If Overdrive is full and the Tongue is attached: **Swallow**
2. If Overdrive is full but the Tongue is severed: **Hunger**
3. If the marked ally has Blink and someone else does not (it looks away) *(reacts)*: **Gaze**
4. If an ally is marked and the Tongue is attached: **Devour**
5. If an ally is marked but the Tongue is severed: **Stare**
6. Otherwise: **Gaze**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Gaze | 3 | Mark | Random ally without Blink (ignores Provoke) | — | Marks a target. Next turn it Devours them (if the Tongue is attached) or Stares. |
| Devour | 3 | Physical | Marked ally | 2.8× ATK (3.2× in phase 2) | Massive damage to the marked ally. Misses if they are airborne; Blink dodges it. |
| Stare | 3 | Stress | Marked ally (ignores Provoke) | — | With no Tongue, it can only stare: +15 Stress to the marked ally. The mark clears. |
| Swallow | 6 | Combined, Physical, Stress | All allies | 1.6× ATK | The star and its Tongue together: heavy damage and +20 Stress to each ally. The Tongue's next turn is synced to the star's. |
| Hunger | 4 | Physical | Lowest-HP% ally | 2.0× ATK | With no Tongue, it vents its Overdrive into the weakest ally. |

- Overdrive fills by 0.6 for every point of Stress your party gains. When it is full, the Overdrive checks at the top of the list fire.
- Checks marked "reacts" are re-checked the moment you act and again when it acts, so it can answer a counter you play after it planned.
- Combined attacks use both actors' turns: the partner's next turn is synced to this one.

### Hellstar Tongue (`tongue`)

1. Every turn: **Lick**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lick | 3 | Physical, Delay | Random ally | 1.0× ATK | Damage and pushes the target back 1 slot. |

- Part of The Hellstar. It re-forms after being defeated and collapses if its parent falls.

### Spiral Ringer (`bell`)

1. If this is its 3rd, 6th, 9th… turn: **Peal**
2. Otherwise: **Toll**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Peal | 3 | Physical | Random ally | 1.9× ATK | One heavy hit. |
| Toll | 3 | Sound, Stress, Physical | All allies | 0.6× ATK | Light damage and +14 Stress to each ally. |

- Every turn, before it acts: +6 Danger. Spiral Cut gets stronger as Danger rises.

### Blood Drinker (`leech`)

1. If it is below 75% HP and did not Drain last turn: **Drain**
2. Otherwise: **Bite**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drain | 3 | Physical, Heal | Lowest-HP% ally | 1.1× ATK | Hits the ally with the lowest HP% and heals itself by the damage dealt. |
| Bite | 3 | Physical, Stress | Random ally | 1.5× ATK | +10 Stress to the target. |

### Funeral Doll (`hand`)

1. If it is the first standing doll to have been countered, and an ally has Counter ready *(reacts)*: **Clutch** → Highest max HP ally without Counter ready
2. Otherwise: **Clutch**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Clutch | 2 | Physical | Highest max HP ally | 1.1× ATK | Fast and light. |

- Comes in groups of 4. Each one acts often (Rank 2).
- The first doll to be countered remembers it: while an ally has Counter ready, that one doll goes for someone else. If it falls, the next countered doll learns.
- Checks marked "reacts" are re-checked the moment you act and again when it acts, so it can answer a counter you play after it planned.

2. Otherwise: **Noose**

| Noose Drop | 3 | Physical, Stress | All allies | 3.8× ATK | Heavy damage and +10 Stress to each ally on the ground. Airborne allies are not hit. |
| Noose | 3 | Physical | Random ally | 0.9× ATK | A single swing. |

### Earthbound Woman (`shell`)

1. Every turn: **Topple**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Topple | 3 | Physical | Random ally | 1.5× ATK | A slow, heavy hit. |

- Very high DEF and Magic DEF: light hits barely hurt her.
- Howl lowers her damage by 20%.
- Every turn she sinks the ground further: +10% damage per turn taken, so long fights get dangerous.

### Red Turtleneck (`fencer`)

1. If an ally has +30% damage or more from crits (Hisui): **Lunge** → Fastest ally below +30% crit damage
2. Otherwise: **Lunge**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lunge | 2 | Physical | Fastest ally | 1.0× ATK | 45% crit chance. |

- Targets the ally with the highest Speed, until crits have given Hisui +30% damage; then it leaves her alone.

### Record Singer (`singer`)

1. Every turn: **Last Song**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Last Song | 3 | Sound, Stress, Physical | All allies | 0.7× ATK | +4 Stress to each ally, then a light hit on one random ally. |

- Comes in groups of 5.
- Counter-Melody cancels the whole Last Song, hit included.

### Long Dreamer (`glass`)

1. If it was Broken since its last turn *(reacts)*: **Rude Awakening**
2. Otherwise: **Dream Lash**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Rude Awakening | 3 | Physical, Stress | All allies | 1.0× ATK | Woken by Break: damage and +10 Stress to each ally, and its damage rises another +25%. |
| Dream Lash | 3 | Physical | Random ally | 1.3× ATK, +25% per turn taken | Its passive adds +25% damage at the start of each of its turns, with no limit. |

- Its damage only grows on turns it takes, so pushing it back keeps it weak.
- Breaking it wakes it angry: its next turn is Rude Awakening, so Break it only when you can use the opening.
- Checks marked "reacts" are re-checked the moment you act and again when it acts, so it can answer a counter you play after it planned.

### Amigara Wall (`tide`)

1. If this is its 9th turn: **The Pull**
2. If Counter-Melody is up *(reacts)*: **Beckon**
3. Otherwise: **Calling**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| The Pull | 3 | Defeat | All allies | — | The party walks into the holes made for them. You lose. |
| Beckon | 4 | Delay | Ally whose turn comes next | — | It waits out the song while a silent hole fits the ally about to act: pushed back 1 slot. Slow (Delay 4). The Counter-Melody fades unused. |
| Calling | 3 | Sound, Stress, Delay, Physical | All allies | 0.6× ATK | Each ally who hears it steps toward the holes: +6 Stress and pushed back 2 slots. Then light damage to all. |

- Nothing stops the countdown.
- If Counter-Melody is up when it acts, it Beckons instead of Calling, and the song fades unused.
- Beckon picks its target when it acts, not when it plans, so the turn order you choose decides who it hits.
- Checks marked "reacts" are re-checked the moment you act and again when it acts, so it can answer a counter you play after it planned.

### Headless Sculpture (`exec`)

1. If Behead was held last turn: **Held Behead**
2. If Provoke is up (Behead waits a turn) *(reacts)*: **Chisel**
3. If it has Chiseled twice since its last Behead: **Behead**
4. Otherwise: **Chisel**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Behead | 3 | Physical | Lowest-HP% ally | 4.6× ATK | Massive damage to the ally with the lowest HP%. |
| Held Behead | 3 | Physical | Lowest-HP% ally (ignores Provoke) | 4.6× ATK | A Behead it waited a turn for. Provoke cannot pull it away; Cover and Blink still work. |
| Chisel | 3 | Physical | Lowest-HP% ally | 1.4× ATK | Always finds the ally with the lowest HP%. |

- Behead comes after two Chisels. If Provoke is up then, it Chisels Kugai instead and holds Behead for one turn; a held Behead ignores Provoke, so cover the weakest.
- Checks marked "reacts" are re-checked the moment you act and again when it acts, so it can answer a counter you play after it planned.

### Grease Father (`pilgrim`)

1. If at least 2 allies have no Earplugs and it did not rain last turn: **Grease Rain**
2. Otherwise: **Slick Fist**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Grease Rain | 3 | Stress | All allies | — | +16 Stress to each ally without Earplugs. +4 Danger. Not a sound attack. |
| Slick Fist | 3 | Physical | Random ally | 1.4× ATK | A greasy punch. |

- Your bag starts empty in this fight.
- 80 DEF; Acid lowers it to 56.
- Grease Rain only falls on allies without Earplugs, and it holds the rain while fewer than 2 of them are exposed.

### Star Fragment (`hour`)

1. If the marked ally has Blink and someone else does not (it looks away) *(reacts)*: **Gaze**
2. If an ally is marked: **Devour**
3. Otherwise: **Gaze**

| Skill | Rank | Tags | Target | Power | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Gaze | 3 | Mark | Random ally without Blink (ignores Provoke) | — | Marks a target. Next turn it Devours them. |
| Devour | 3 | Physical | Marked ally | 6.0× ATK | Massive damage to the marked ally. Misses if they are airborne; Blink dodges it. |

- Provoke redirects Devour to Kugai.
- Blink on the marked ally makes it look away and Gaze at someone without Blink. Once everyone has Blink it Devours anyway.
- Checks marked "reacts" are re-checked the moment you act and again when it acts, so it can answer a counter you play after it planned.
